channel.title: Th’die’s Cast
channel.description: Audio tools for tabletop games, hosted by Brother Rubicon: roll dice, discover wilderness encounters, and time disasters. A five-episode pilot season. No companion app required.

channel.itunes:summary: Useful audio tools for tabletop games with Brother Rubicon.
channel.itunes:subtitle: Dice, encounters, and audio clocks for the tabletop

item.title: 05 · Ten Minutes to Disaster
item.description: An original ten-minute suspense soundtrack and functional countdown. It begins with playback, provides a few time warnings, and ends with a decisive bell at exactly ten minutes. These are working pilot releases; details may change with future revisions.

item.title: 04 · The Wilderness Oracle
item.description: Eighty original, independent wilderness encounters, each with a subtle boundary cue. Seek and wait for the next complete encounter. Printed numbers and titles are not spoken. These are working pilot releases; details may change with future revisions.

item.title: 03 · D100
item.description: One uniformly generated number from 1 through 100 at a time. Seek to a random point and take the next complete value. The number 100 is read as one hundred. These are working pilot releases; details may change with future revisions.

item.title: 02 · 2D6
item.description: Two independent six-sided dice, followed by their sum. Seek to a random point and use the next complete result. The familiar bell-shaped total distribution emerges naturally. These are working pilot releases; details may change with future revisions.

item.title: 01 · D20
item.description: Thirty minutes of twenty-sided die results. Seek to a random point and use the next complete number. For this pilot, each set of twenty faces is shuffled before the next set. These are working pilot releases; details may change with future revisions.
